newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Commonwealth cuts key business rate. [CORRECTED 04:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Commonwealth cuts key business rate. [CORRECTED 04:00 GMT]

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said on Friday it would cut its prime business lending rate by 50 basis points to 9.75 percent, effective December 2.
The bank also said it would cut its rate for other non-prime business borrowers by the same amount to 10.25 percent.
CBA said it would cut its personal credit card interest rates by 60 basis points, effective November 18.

The rate on cards with up to 55 days interest free would be cut to 16.1 percent (bank corrects from 16.35 percent), while those with no interest free period would be cut to 15.1 percent (bank corrects from 15.35 percent).

Recent rate reductions by Australia's finance sector follows the Reserve Bank's monetary policy easing on Wednesday which lowered the official cash rate to 6.50 percent from 7.0 percent. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
